[Date]

Anthem Blue Cross Blue Shield  
Attn: Appeals  
[Appeals mailing address or fax number]

Re: Appeal of Adverse Benefit Determination  
Member: Casey Kimura  
Member ID: W414616133  
Reference number: POC-3A74C3E137-54728  
Requested service: Total hip replacement  
CPT code: 27130  
Denial date: August 13, 2026

Dear Appeals Reviewer:

I am appealing Anthem’s denial of prior authorization for my total hip replacement. The denial states that the submitted records did not document an adequate trial of conservative treatment.

The records do document an extensive and unsuccessful course of conservative treatment:

- I completed 14 weeks of supervised physical therapy from March 13, 2026, through June 19, 2026, consisting of 18 visits. The therapy focused on hip abductor strengthening and gait, and the physical therapy discharge note documents completion.
- I used NSAIDs for six months without adequate relief.
- I received a corticosteroid injection on April 6, 2026. It provided only two weeks of partial relief.
- My symptoms have continued and progressively worsened for approximately 12 months despite these treatments.

The publicly available Carelon Joint Surgery guideline identified for Anthem’s musculoskeletal medical-necessity reviews is Clinical Appropriateness Guidelines — Musculoskeletal Appropriate Use Criteria: Joint Surgery, document MSK02-1125.1, effective November 15, 2025. I am not quoting the plan’s language in this letter. Anthem should nevertheless evaluate my records under the exact criteria actually applied to this request and provide those criteria if they differ from the publicly available guideline.

My treatment exceeds the documented conservative-treatment duration associated with the identified guideline. I completed 14 weeks of supervised therapy, in addition to six months of NSAID treatment and a corticosteroid injection with only brief partial benefit. The records therefore directly address the stated basis for denial.

The records also establish significant disease and functional impairment:

- Weight-bearing AP pelvis radiographs on July 19, 2026, showed superolateral joint-space narrowing to 1 mm, subchondral sclerosis, and osteophytes.
- I have progressive hip pain that is not relieved by rest.
- I require a cane for ambulation and can walk only approximately one block.
- I cannot put on my shoes without assistance.
- Examination showed positive provocative testing on the affected side and range of motion limited by pain.

The records do not identify a contraindication to surgery. They document no active infection, no untreated substance use, a BMI of 29, and no smoking. The requested procedure has been recommended by Duval, MD, orthopedic surgery, based on the documented symptoms, examination findings, imaging, functional limitations, and failure of conservative treatment.

Please overturn the denial and authorize CPT 27130. If Anthem believes additional information is required, please identify specifically what documentation is missing and allow the treating surgeon an opportunity to submit it or participate in a peer-to-peer review.

Please also provide a copy of the exact medical-necessity policy, clinical utilization-management guideline, or other review criteria applied to this request, including any plan-specific modifications. If Anthem relied on criteria other than the publicly available Carelon Joint Surgery guideline, please identify those criteria.

This appeal must be received by February 9, 2027. Please send written confirmation of receipt and the appeal determination.

Sincerely,

Casey Kimura
